title: Peasant Uprisings - Phulaguri Dhewa & Patharughat (Bilingual English & Assamese)
subject: Modern Assam History

questions.question_en: In which year did the Phulaguri uprising take place?
questions.question_as: কোন চনত ফুলগুৰি বিদ্ৰোহ সংঘটিত হৈছিল?

questions.question_en: At which village did the Phulaguri uprising take place?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি বিদ্ৰোহ কোন গাঁৱত সংঘটিত হৈছিল?
questions.answer_en: At Phulaguri, in the Nagaon (Nowgong) district of Assam.

questions.question_en: By what name is the Phulaguri uprising popularly known?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি বিদ্ৰোহ কাক বুলি জনা যায়?
questions.answer_en: Phulaguri Dhewa.

questions.question_en: Which British officer was killed by the peasants during the Phulaguri uprising?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি বিদ্ৰোহত কৃষকসকলে কোন ব্ৰিটিছ বিষয়াক হত্যা কৰিছিল?
questions.answer_en: Lt. Singer, the Magistrate (Assistant Commissioner).

questions.question_en: Which tax did the Phulaguri peasants refuse to pay?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰিৰ কৃষকসকলে কোনটো কৰ দিবলৈ অস্বীকাৰ কৰিছিল?
questions.answer_en: The opium tax.

questions.question_en: What was the main cause of the Phulaguri uprising?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি বিদ্ৰোহৰ মূল কাৰণ কি আছিল?
questions.answer_en: The British raised land revenue and imposed heavy taxes, including the opium tax.
questions.answer_as: ব্ৰিটিছসকলে মাটিৰ ৰাজহ বৃদ্ধি কৰিছিল আৰু আফিং কৰকে ধৰি গধুৰ কৰ জাপি দিছিল।

questions.question_en: In which district of Assam is Phulaguri located?
questions.question_as: অসমৰ কোন জিলাত ফুলগুৰি অৱস্থিত?
questions.answer_en: In the Nagaon (Nowgong) district.

questions.question_en: How is the Phulaguri uprising regarded in the history of Assam?
questions.question_as: অসমৰ ইতিহাসত ফুলগুৰি বিদ্ৰোহক কেনেকৈ গণ্য কৰা হয়?
questions.answer_en: As one of the first major peasant uprisings against British rule in Assam.
questions.answer_as: ব্ৰিটিছ শাসনৰ বিৰুদ্ধে অসমৰ প্ৰথম মুখ্য কৃষক বিদ্ৰোহসমূহৰ ভিতৰত অন্যতম হিচাপে।

questions.question_en: In which year did the Patharughat uprising take place?
questions.question_as: কোন চনত পাঠৰুঘাট বিদ্ৰোহ সংঘটিত হৈছিল?

questions.question_en: Where is Patharughat located?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাট ক'ত অৱস্থিত?
questions.answer_en: In the present Darrang district of Assam.

questions.question_en: By what other name is the Patharughat uprising known?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাট বিদ্ৰোহ কাক বুলিও কোৱা হয়?
questions.answer_en: Patharughat Raijmel.

questions.question_en: What is a 'Raijmel'?
questions.question_as: 'ৰাইজমেল' বুলি কি বুজা যায়?
questions.answer_en: A people's assembly (public gathering of the peasants).

questions.question_en: On which date did the police open fire on the peasants at Patharughat?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাটত আৰক্ষীয়ে কৃষকসকলৰ ওপৰত কোন তাৰিখে গুলি চলাইছিল?
questions.answer_en: On 28 January 1894.

questions.question_en: What was the main cause of the Patharughat uprising?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাট বিদ্ৰোহৰ মূল কাৰণ কি আছিল?
questions.answer_en: The British greatly enhanced the land revenue in Darrang district.
questions.answer_as: ব্ৰিটিছসকলে দৰং জিলাত মাটিৰ ৰাজহ বহু পৰিমাণে বৃদ্ধি কৰিছিল।

questions.question_en: Who opened fire on the unarmed peasants at Patharughat?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাটত নিৰস্ত্ৰ কৃষকসকলৰ ওপৰত কোনে গুলি চলাইছিল?
questions.answer_en: The police (and military).

questions.question_en: Were the Patharughat peasants armed when the firing took place?
questions.question_as: গুলিবৰ্ষণৰ সময়ত পাঠৰুঘাটৰ কৃষকসকল সশস্ত্ৰ আছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No, they were unarmed.

questions.question_en: What are the peasants killed at Patharughat remembered as?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাটত নিহত হোৱা কৃষকসকলক কিহিচাবে স্মৰণ কৰা হয়?
questions.answer_en: As the Patharughat martyrs.

questions.question_en: What is the Patharughat firing incident also called?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাটৰ গুলিবৰ্ষণ ঘটনাটোক কাক বুলিও কোৱা হয়?
questions.answer_en: The Patharughat Massacre.

questions.question_en: How did the peasants protest before the firing at Patharughat?
questions.question_as: গুলিবৰ্ষণৰ আগত পাঠৰুঘাটৰ কৃষকসকলে কেনেকৈ প্ৰতিবাদ জনাইছিল?
questions.answer_en: They organized a peaceful Raijmel (people's assembly).
questions.answer_as: তেওঁলোকে শান্তিপূর্ণ ৰাইজমেল (জনসভা) পাতি প্ৰতিবাদ জনাইছিল।

questions.question_en: The enhancement of land revenue in which district caused the Patharughat uprising?
questions.question_as: কোন জিলাত মাটিৰ ৰাজহ বৃদ্ধি হোৱাই পাঠৰুঘাট বিদ্ৰোহত কাৰণ হৈছিল?
questions.answer_en: Darrang district.

questions.question_en: Which two uprisings are studied under this topic?
questions.question_as: এই বিষয়ত অধ্যয়ন কৰা দুটা বিদ্ৰোহ কোন কোনটো?
questions.answer_en: Phulaguri Dhewa (1861) and the Patharughat uprising (1894).

questions.question_en: What common grievance did both the Phulaguri and Patharughat uprisings share?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি আৰু পাঠৰুঘাট দুয়োটা বিদ্ৰোহৰে সাধাৰণ অভিযোগটো কি আছিল?
questions.answer_en: Both were protests against the heavy land revenue and taxes imposed by the British.
questions.answer_as: দুয়োটাৱেই ব্ৰিটিছে জাপি দিয়া গধুৰ মাটিৰ ৰাজহ আৰু কৰৰ বিৰুদ্ধে প্ৰতিবাদ আছিল।

questions.question_en: How many people were killed in the Patharughat firing?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাট গুলিবৰ্ষণত কিমান লোক নিহত হৈছিল?
questions.answer_en: A large number (scores) of people were killed.

questions.question_en: In which month did the firing on the Patharughat Raijmel take place?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাট ৰাইজমেলত গুলিবৰ্ষণ কোন মাহত হৈছিল?
questions.answer_en: In January (28 January 1894).

questions.question_en: Which uprising occurred earlier - Phulaguri or Patharughat?
questions.question_as: কোনটো বিদ্ৰোহ পূৰ্বে হৈছিল - ফুলগুৰি নে পাঠৰুঘাট?
questions.answer_en: The Phulaguri uprising (in 1861).

questions.question_en: Was Lt. Singer, the officer killed in the Phulaguri clash, killed at Patharughat?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি সংঘর্ষত নিহত হোৱা বিষয়া লেফটেনেণ্ট ছিংগাৰ পাঠৰুঘাটত নিহত হৈছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No. Lt. Singer was killed at Phulaguri in 1861.
questions.answer_as: নহয়। লেফটেনেণ্ট ছিংগাৰ ১৮৬১ চনত ফুলগুৰিত নিহত হৈছিল।

questions.question_en: Did the Phulaguri Dhewa take place in 1894?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি ধেৱা ১৮৯৪ চনত হৈছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No. It took place in 1861.

questions.question_en: Did the Patharughat uprising take place in 1861?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাট বিদ্ৰোহ ১৮৬১ চনত হৈছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No. It took place in 1894.

questions.question_en: Is Phulaguri located in the Darrang district?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি দৰং জিলাত অৱস্থিতনে?
questions.answer_en: No. Phulaguri is located in the Nagaon (Nowgong) district.

questions.question_en: Is Patharughat located in the Nagaon district?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাট নগাঁও জিলাত অৱস্থিতনে?
questions.answer_en: No. Patharughat is located in the Darrang district.

questions.question_en: Was the opium tax a cause of the Patharughat uprising?
questions.question_as: আফিং কৰ পাঠৰুঘাট বিদ্ৰোহৰ কাৰণ আছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No. The opium tax was a cause of the Phulaguri uprising; Patharughat was caused by the land revenue hike.
questions.answer_as: নহয়। আফিং কৰ ফুলগুৰি বিদ্ৰোহৰ কাৰণ আছিল; পাঠৰুঘাট হৈছিল মাটিৰ ৰাজহ বৃদ্ধিৰ বাবে।

questions.question_en: Did the police fire on the peasants at Phulaguri?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰিত আৰক্ষীয়ে কৃষকসকলৰ ওপৰত গুলি চলাইছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No. At Phulaguri the peasants killed Lt. Singer in the clash; the mass firing on peasants happened at Patharughat in 1894.
questions.answer_as: নহয়। ফুলগুৰি সংঘর্ষত কৃষকসকলে লেফটেনেণ্ট ছিংগাৰক হত্যা কৰিছিল; ১৮৯৪ চনত পাঠৰুঘাটত কৃষকসকলৰ ওপৰত ব্যাপক গুলিবৰ্ষণ হৈছিল।

questions.question_en: What happened to Lt. Singer during the Phulaguri clash?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি সংঘর্ষত লেফটেনেণ্ট ছিংগাৰৰ কি হৈছিল?
questions.answer_en: He was killed by the angry peasants.

questions.question_en: Was the Patharughat protest violent or peaceful in nature?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাটৰ প্ৰতিবাদটো হিংসাত্মক আছিল নে শান্তিপূর্ণ?
questions.answer_en: It was peaceful - the peasants organized a Raijmel (people's assembly).

questions.question_en: What was the nature of the Phulaguri clash?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি সংঘর্ষৰ স্বৰূপ কেনে আছিল?
questions.answer_en: It was violent - a British officer (Lt. Singer) was killed by the peasants.
questions.answer_as: হিংসাত্মক আছিল - কৃষকসকলে এজন ব্ৰিটিছ বিষয়া (লেফটেনেণ্ট ছিংগাৰ)ক হত্যা কৰিছিল।

questions.question_en: Which event happened first - the Patharughat firing or the Phulaguri Dhewa?
questions.question_as: কোনটো ঘটনা পূৰ্বে ঘটিছিল - পাঠৰুঘাট গুলিবৰ্ষণ নে ফুলগুৰি ধেৱা?
questions.answer_en: The Phulaguri Dhewa (in 1861).

questions.question_en: With which event is the village of Phulaguri associated?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি গাঁও কোন ঘটনাৰ সৈতে জড়িত?
questions.answer_en: With the peasant uprising of 1861, called the Phulaguri Dhewa.
questions.answer_as: ১৮৬১ চনৰ কৃষক বিদ্ৰোহ, অৰ্থাৎ ফুলগুৰি ধেৱাৰ সৈতে।

questions.question_en: What does the word 'Dhewa' in 'Phulaguri Dhewa' signify?
questions.question_as: 'ফুলগুৰি ধেৱা'ত 'ধেৱা' শব্দই কি বুজায়?
questions.answer_en: It signifies an uprising (a mass upheaval or rebellion).

questions.question_en: What do the Patharughat martyrs symbolize?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাট শ্বহীদসকলে কি বুজায়?
questions.answer_en: They symbolize peasant sacrifice in resistance against oppressive British taxation.
questions.answer_as: ব্ৰিটিছৰ অত্যাচাৰী ৰাজহ ব্যৱস্থাৰ বিৰুদ্ধে কৃষক প্ৰতিৰোধৰ আত্মদানৰ প্ৰতীক।

questions.question_en: Who organized the Raijmel at Patharughat?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাটত ৰাইজমেল কোনে আয়োজন কৰিছিল?
questions.answer_en: The peasants of Darrang district.

questions.question_en: Against what did the Patharughat peasants protest peacefully?
questions.question_as: পাঠৰুঘাটৰ কৃষকসকলে কাৰ বিৰুদ্ধে শান্তিপূর্ণভাৱে প্ৰতিবাদ জনাইছিল?
questions.answer_en: Against the sharp increase in land revenue in Darrang district.
questions.answer_as: দৰং জিলাত মাটিৰ ৰাজহ অত্যধিক বৃদ্ধি কৰাৰ বিৰুদ্ধে।

questions.question_en: Did the Phulaguri uprising occur because of a reduction in taxes?
questions.question_as: কৰ হ্রাস হোৱা বাবেই ফুলগুৰি বিদ্ৰোহ হৈছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No. It occurred because the British enhanced the land revenue and imposed heavy taxes such as the opium tax.
questions.answer_as: নহয়। ব্ৰিটিছে মাটিৰ ৰাজহ বৃদ্ধি কৰি আফিং কৰৰ দৰে গধুৰ কৰ জাপি দিয়া বাবেই ই সংঘটিত হৈছিল।

questions.question_en: What official position did Lt. Singer hold at the time of the Phulaguri uprising?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি বিদ্ৰোহৰ সময়ত লেফটেনেণ্ট ছিংগাৰে কোন পদত কাৰ্য্যনিৰ্বাহ কৰিছিল?
questions.answer_en: He was the Magistrate (Assistant Commissioner).

questions.question_en: Which uprising is regarded as one of the first major peasant uprisings against the British in Assam?
questions.question_as: অসমত ব্ৰিটিছ শাসনৰ বিৰুদ্ধে প্ৰথম মুখ্য কৃষক বিদ্ৰোহসমূহৰ ভিতৰত কোনটো অন্যতম বুলি গণ্য কৰা হয়?
questions.answer_en: The Phulaguri Dhewa (1861).

questions.question_en: Against what did both the Phulaguri and Patharughat uprisings protest?
questions.question_as: ফুলগুৰি আৰু পাঠৰুঘাট দুয়োটা বিদ্ৰোহই কাৰ বিৰুদ্ধে প্ৰতিবাদ জনাইছিল?
questions.answer_en: Against the heavy land revenue and taxes imposed by the British.
questions.answer_as: ব্ৰিটিছে জাপি দিয়া গধুৰ মাটিৰ ৰাজহ আৰু কৰৰ বিৰুদ্ধে।
